intended_object: The terminal sheaf: given a terminal object X of A, the constant presheaf with value X is a J-sheaf, and it is terminal in Sheaf J A (inferred from the docstring and the name).
explanation: The body is the constant functor at X. Its sheaf property comes from Presheaf.isSheaf_of_isTerminal: a constant presheaf at a terminal object is a sheaf, since every matching family has exactly one amalgamation. This is the standard construction of the terminal sheaf. The site, the coefficient category and the terminal object are all arbitrary, so the definition is at its natural generality.
